question: Describe a time you debugged a complex production issue. What was your approach?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: At my company, our API response times spiked from 200ms to 2s. Situation: users reported slow page loads. I used distributed tracing to identify a slow database query. I added an index and optimized the query. Result: response times returned to normal, and I added monitoring alerts to catch similar issues early.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
Focusing on process without mentioning personal contribution
Failing to connect to the target role
evaluationCriteria: Clarity, debugging, specific examples, measurable outcomes
followUpQuestions: How does this apply to the Track-A role?
Can you provide more specific examples?
What would you do differently next time?
